sourceDescription: NMC letter D-11011/500/2024-AcademicCell dated 12-09-2024 with CBME Curriculum 2024 and competency volumes; Pathology (CODE: PA) table read at text offsets 250000-400000 of 801400.
verification: Official NMC document text read through a web reader that quotes short rows and restates long rows; first 60 rows also cross-read against a university reproduction of the same table (https://www.mgmuhs.com/Pathology_(CBME).pdf). PDF bytes, the pinned SHA-256, sourceBodySha256 values, rendered pages and table-cell alignment were not independently verified. Identity of this file with the pinned source PDF is assumed from title and date, not proven. No source prose stored.
scope: All 174 Pathology references that lacked selected review evidence at the checked head: the 60-reference queue PA1.1-PA16.2 and the remaining 114 (PA16.3-PA35.1).
limits: Editorial scope comparison only; no clinical, faculty, rights or canonical acceptance.
New holds are recorded here only; the 154-reference original hold inventory is unchanged.

The official row begins with the etiology of cell injury before the reversible/irreversible distinction; the draft task covers mechanisms and morphology only. Etiology may be carried by PA2.1, but that reliance is not recorded.
rows.evidenceToResolve: Add the etiology element in a versioned task revision, or record an explicit decision that PA2.1 carries it.
